generation.scope: For every finite-Frobenius point graph with one-dimensional image and point projection fibers, the total curve degree is at most seven including multiplicities. The third Picard difference vanishes and the degree of each component is constant across positions. The unique smooth elliptic quartic, when present, has second difference killed by twelve. A disjoint isolated residual to a smooth curve has length 18-4d+2g.

open_mathematics: Recover the resolution of each elliptic quartic quotient by evaluation on its curve and determine regularity from the two quadrics in its kernel; other curve types and positive-dimensional fibers remain.
